author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the world of Moonlight Peaks in this trailer for the upcoming supernatural life-sim game. Moonlight Peaks will be available on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, and Nintendo Switch on July 7, 2026.

Welcome to your new vampiric life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks. Raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, and befriend – or even romance – the local werewolves, witches, and mermaids in this heartwarming supernatural life-sim. Eternity awaits!
title: Moonlight Peaks - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Old World: Empires of the Indus announcement trailer for this upcoming DLC for the historical 4X strategy game. Empires of the Indus throws you into a vibrant, turbulent world grappling with the rise of mighty dynasties and challenger states that shaped the region for centuries to come.

From the mighty Mauryas, who founded one of the greatest Iron Age empires under the rule of Emperor Ahosoka, to the nomadic horse lords of the Yuezhi who transformed the region as the Kushan Empire, and the illustrious, culturally rich Sangam kingdoms of Tamilakam, players will spread their domain across South Asia – from the northern reaches of the Indus valley and Bactria, to the southern tip of the subcontinent. title: Old World: Empires of the Indus - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest Lightyear Frontier trailer for the intergalactic open-world farming adventure game to see what's coming in the newest update. The Automation Update will implement new features and overhauled systems to take mech-powered farming to the next level. The Automation Update also features quality-of-life improvements and player-requested features, including automated crafting, changes to the fuel system and a new Exofarmer jetpack for navigation. The Automation Update for Lightyear Frontier will be available on March 5, 2026.
title: Lightyear Frontier - Official Automation Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Join the developers Gamhalla for a behind-the-scenes look at Unsealed: The Mare and get a deep dive into what inspired the horror aspect of the upcoming first-person psychological horror game, where you play as Vera, trapped in a nightmare tied to her family’s tragic past. In Unsealed: The Mare, find and destroy cursed objects and restore lost memories to unlock sealed doors, reveal hidden areas, and survive challenging, terrifying encounters. Unsealed: The Mare will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC on March 10, 2026.
title: Unsealed: The Mare - Official Behind The Fear Video
